g.text: R37 0.1R 1 % 2 W carries the return current of every valve: ISNS is the common T1 node of all triacs.

g.desc: R37 0.1R 1 % 2 W carries the return current of every valve: ISNS is the common T1 node of all triacs.

g.text: 0.23 W at 1.5 A rms. A 20 A short lifts ISNS to 2.8 V for a half-cycle; the 7.5k input resistors

g.desc: 0.23 W at 1.5 A rms. A 20 A short lifts ISNS to 2.8 V for a half-cycle; the 7.5k input resistors

g.text: keep that inside the op-amp's 2 mA input limit.

g.desc: keep that inside the op-amp's 2 mA input limit.

g.text: 665.3 mV/A, linear to 1.17 A peak. Both outputs are AC waveforms centred on VB, about 0.79 V.

g.desc: 665.3 mV/A, linear to 1.17 A peak. Both outputs are AC waveforms centred on VB, about 0.79 V.

g.text: Firmware takes the rms over 100 ms windows; there is no rectifier. C26 to C29: 15 kHz.

g.desc: Firmware takes the rms over 100 ms windows; there is no rectifier. C26 to C29: 15 kHz.

g.text: R46 with C30 and R47 with C31: 1.6 kHz at the ADC pins; place the capacitors at module pins 39, 38.

g.desc: R46 with C30 and R47 with C31: 1.6 kHz at the ADC pins; place the capacitors at module pins 39, 38.

g.text: LAYOUT: Kelvin connections. R38 and R42 go to the ISNS pad of R37, R40 and R44 to its ground pad

g.desc: LAYOUT: Kelvin connections. R38 and R42 go to the ISNS pad of R37, R40 and R44 to its ground pad

g.text: with their own trace, not to the ground plane. Keep this block away from L1, the display clock

g.desc: with their own trace, not to the ground plane. Keep this block away from L1, the display clock

g.text: THRESHOLDS (section 9.1). VH 1.425 V, VB 0.806 V, VL 0.188 V: trip at 0.619 V / 0.1333 V/A = 4.64 A peak.

g.desc: THRESHOLDS (section 9.1). VH 1.425 V, VB 0.806 V, VL 0.188 V: trip at 0.619 V / 0.1333 V/A = 4.64 A peak.

g.text: ZERO-CROSS (section 11). R55, R88, R56 divide AC_L by 12. D9 clamps; R88 halves the clamped level so

g.desc: ZERO-CROSS (section 11). R55, R88, R56 divide AC_L by 12. D9 clamps; R88 halves the clamped level so

g.text: the LM2901 input stays above -0.3 V (-0.18 V at -20 C and 32 VAC). U6D compares with VL; R57 adds

g.desc: the LM2901 input stays above -0.3 V (-0.18 V at -20 C and 32 VAC). U6D compares with VL; R57 adds

g.text: 30 mV of hysteresis. AC_ZC is a square wave at mains frequency, high while AC_L is above about 2.3 V.

g.desc: 30 mV of hysteresis. AC_ZC is a square wave at mains frequency, high while AC_L is above about 2.3 V.

g.text: No edge for 25 ms means the 24 VAC is gone. R55 is a 1206 part rated 200 V.

g.desc: No edge for 25 ms means the 24 VAC is gone. R55 is a 1206 part rated 200 V.

g.text: Shunt and two difference amplifiers, both biased at VB

g.desc: Shunt and two difference amplifiers, both biased at VB
